subject.title: feat(gateway): title untitled sessions when their discussion opens

question: Should opening an untitled session discussion be allowed to make a best-effort utility-model request and wait up to 10 seconds so the external channel is born with a generated title?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally fail-open, but it changes a user-triggered gateway operation's latency and model-consumption policy; tests cannot determine whether that tradeoff is the desired product default.

options.title: Approve bounded titling at open
options.body: Accept the one-shot, fail-open title attempt as the default for untitled discussion opens after live proof confirms the expected operator experience.

options.title: Keep opening immediate
options.body: Avoid model work on the open path and rely on existing naming and reconciliation behavior until a title is already available.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded titling at open
recommendation.body: Accept the one-shot, fail-open title attempt as the default for untitled discussion opens after live proof confirms the expected operator experience.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged feature and this proposed gateway follow-up show the strongest available connection to the discussion-title design.
